spec.code:
/-- `ip` lies in `c`: the first `prefix_len` bits agree (all of them when the
prefix exceeds the width), same address family. -/
def inCidr (c : net.CidrRange) (ip : net.IpAddr) : Bool :=
  match c.network, ip with
  | .V4 n, .V4 a => let s := 32 - min c.prefix_len.val 32; n.val / 2 ^ s == a.val / 2 ^ s
  | .V6 n, .V6 a => let s := 128 - min c.prefix_len.val 128; n.val / 2 ^ s == a.val / 2 ^ s
  | _, _ => false

    Source: 'src/net.rs', lines 77:4-101:5
    Visibility: public -/
def net.CidrRange.contains
  (self : net.CidrRange) (ip : net.IpAddr) : Result Bool := do
  match self.network with
  | net.IpAddr.V4 nw =>
    match ip with
    | net.IpAddr.V4 ip1 =>
      let mask ←
        if self.prefix_len = 0#u8
        then ok 0#u32
        else
          if self.prefix_len >= 32#u8
          then ok core.num.U32.MAX
          else
            do
            let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 self.prefix_len)
            let i1 ← 32#u32 - i
            core.num.U32.MAX <<< i1
      let i ← lift (nw &&& mask)
      let i1 ← lift (ip1 &&& mask)
      ok (i = i1)
    | net.IpAddr.V6 _ => ok false
  | net.IpAddr.V6 nw =>
    match ip with
    | net.IpAddr.V4 _ => ok false
    | net.IpAddr.V6 ip1 =>
      let mask ←
        if self.prefix_len = 0#u8
        then ok 0#u128
        else
          if self.prefix_len >= 128#u8
          then ok core.num.U128.MAX
          else
            do
            let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 self.prefix_len)
            let i1 ← 128#u32 - i
            core.num.U128.MAX <<< i1
      let i ← lift (nw &&& mask)
      let i1 ← lift (ip1 &&& mask)
      ok (i = i1)

/-- Masking with the top `w - k` bits of a `w`-bit word keeps `n` rounded down to a multiple of `2 ^ k`. -/
theorem and_mask (w k n : Nat) (hn : n < 2 ^ w) :
    n &&& (((2 ^ w - 1) <<< k) % 2 ^ w) = 2 ^ k * (n / 2 ^ k) := by
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
  intro i
  simp only [Nat.testBit_and, Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow, Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.testBit_mul_two_pow,
    Nat.testBit_two_pow_sub_one, Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul, Nat.testBit_div_two_pow]
  by_cases hi : i < w
  · by_cases hk : k ≤ i
    · have : i - k + k = i := by omega
      simp [hi, hk, this]; omega
    · simp [hk]
  · have : n.testBit i = false := Nat.testBit_eq_false_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)))
    by_cases hk : k ≤ i
    · have : i - k + k = i := by omega
      simp [*]
    · simp [hk]

/-- Masked equality compares the words with their low `k` bits dropped. -/
theorem and_mask_eq {ty} (n a m : UScalar ty) (k : Nat)
    (hm : m.val = ((2 ^ ty.numBits - 1) <<< k) % 2 ^ ty.numBits) :
    decide ((n &&& m) = (a &&& m)) = (n.val / 2 ^ k == a.val / 2 ^ k) := by
  have hn : n.val < 2 ^ ty.numBits := by simpa [UScalar.size] using n.hBounds
  have ha : a.val < 2 ^ ty.numBits := by simpa [UScalar.size] using a.hBounds
  have e : (n &&& m = a &&& m) ↔ n.val / 2 ^ k = a.val / 2 ^ k := by
    rw [UScalar.eq_equiv]
    rw [UScalar.val_and, UScalar.val_and, hm, and_mask _ _ _ hn, and_mask _ _ _ ha]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.two_pow_pos k) h
    · intro h; rw [h]
  simp only [e]; rfl

/-- The extracted `CidrRange::contains` computes `inCidr`. -/

theorem mask_eq_iff (width shift : Nat) (network address : BitVec width) :
    network &&& (BitVec.allOnes width <<< shift) =
      address &&& (BitVec.allOnes width <<< shift) ↔
    network.toNat / 2 ^ shift = address.toNat / 2 ^ shift := by
  have mask_right (value : BitVec width) :
      (value &&& (BitVec.allOnes width <<< shift)) >>> shift = value >>> shift := by
    apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
    intro index
    by_cases inside : shift + index < width
    · simp [inside, show ¬ shift + index < shift by omega]
    · simp [BitVec.getLsbD_of_ge, show width ≤ shift + index by omega]
  constructor
  · intro equal
    have shifted := congrArg (fun value : BitVec width => value >>> shift) equal
    rw [mask_right, mask_right] at shifted
    simpa [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow] using congrArg BitVec.toNat shifted
  · intro equal
    have shifted : network >>> shift = address >>> shift := by
      apply BitVec.eq_of_toNat_eq
      simpa [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow] using equal
    simpa only [BitVec.shiftLeft_ushiftRight] using
      congrArg (fun value : BitVec width => value <<< shift) shifted

theorem cidr_contains_spec (c : net.CidrRange) (a : net.IpAddr) :
    c.contains a = ok (inCidr c a) := by
  apply eq_ok_of_spec
  unfold net.CidrRange.contains
  cases hn : c.network <;> cases a
  all_goals try simp [inCidr, hn]
  all_goals
    rename_i network address
    split
    · step*
      simp_all [UScalar.eq_equiv]
      rw [Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by scalar_tac), Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by scalar_tac)]
    · split
      · step*
        apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, beq_iff_eq, UScalar.eq_equiv_bv_eq,
          i_post1, i1_post1]
        simp_all only [Nat.min_eq_right, Nat.sub_self, Nat.pow_zero, Nat.div_one]
        simp_all
        have masked := mask_eq_iff _ 0 network.bv address.bv
        simp only [BitVec.shiftLeft_zero, Nat.pow_zero, Nat.div_one, UScalar.bv_toNat] at masked
        exact masked
      · step*
        apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, beq_iff_eq, UScalar.eq_equiv_bv_eq,
          i_post1, i1_post1, mask_post1]
        simp_all
        exact mask_eq_iff _ _ _ _

lemma two_pow_sub_two_pow_eq (W s : Nat) (hs : s ≤ W) :
    2^W - 2^s = (2^(W - s) - 1) * 2^s := by
  have hpow : 2^W = 2^(W - s) * 2^s := by
    rw [← Nat.pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hs]
  rw [hpow, Nat.sub_mul, Nat.one_mul]

lemma testBit_two_pow_sub_two_pow (W s j : Nat) (hs : s ≤ W) :
    Nat.testBit (2^W - 2^s) j = (decide (s ≤ j) && decide (j < W)) := by
  rw [two_pow_sub_two_pow_eq W s hs]
  rw [Nat.testBit_mul_two_pow, Nat.testBit_two_pow_sub_one]
  by_cases hj : s ≤ j
  · simp [hj]
    omega
  · simp [hj]

lemma nat_and_mask_eq_div_mul (W s x : Nat) (hs : s ≤ W) (hx : x < 2^W) :
    x &&& (2^W - 2^s) = (x / 2^s) * 2^s := by
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
  intro j
  rw [Nat.testBit_and, testBit_two_pow_sub_two_pow W s j hs, Nat.testBit_mul_two_pow]
  rw [Nat.testBit_div_two_pow]
  by_cases hj : s ≤ j
  · have hjs : j - s + s = j := Nat.sub_add_cancel hj
    rw [hjs]
    by_cases hjW : j < W
    · simp [hj, hjW]
    · have hj_ge : W ≤ j := by omega
      have h2 : 2^W ≤ 2^j := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hj_ge
      have hx_lt : x < 2^j := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hx h2
      have hx_bit : Nat.testBit x j = false := Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow hx_lt
      simp [hj, hjW, hx_bit]
  · simp [hj]

lemma nat_and_mask_eq_iff_div_eq (W s x y : Nat) (hs : s ≤ W) (hx : x < 2^W) (hy : y < 2^W) :
    (x &&& (2^W - 2^s) = y &&& (2^W - 2^s)) ↔ (x / 2^s = y / 2^s) := by
  rw [nat_and_mask_eq_div_mul W s x hs hx, nat_and_mask_eq_div_mul W s y hs hy]
  have hpos : 0 < 2^s := Nat.two_pow_pos s
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hpos h
  · intro h
    rw [h]

lemma mask_val_eq (W s : Nat) (hs_pos : 0 < s) (hs_lt : s < W) :
    ((2^W - 1) * 2^s) % 2^W = 2^W - 2^s := by
  have hs_le : s ≤ W := by omega
  have h2W_ge_1 : 1 ≤ 2^W := by
    have : 2^0 ≤ 2^W := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
    exact this
  have h2s_ge_1 : 1 ≤ 2^s := by
    have : 2^0 ≤ 2^s := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
    exact this
  have h2s_le_2W : 2^s ≤ 2^W := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hs_le
  have h_alg : (2^W - 1) * 2^s = 2^W * (2^s - 1) + (2^W - 2^s) := by
    zify [h2W_ge_1, h2s_ge_1, h2s_le_2W]
    ring
  rw [h_alg]
  rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.mul_comm (2^W), Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right]
  have h_lt : 2^W - 2^s < 2^W := by
    have : 0 < 2^s := Nat.two_pow_pos s
    omega
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h_lt

lemma mask_val_u32 (s : Nat) (hs_pos : 0 < s) (hs_lt : s < 32) :
    (⟨ core.num.U32.MAX.bv.shiftLeft s ⟩ : U32).val = 2^32 - 2^s := by
  change (core.num.U32.MAX.bv.shiftLeft s).toNat = 2^32 - 2^s
  rw [BitVec.shiftLeft_eq, BitVec.toNat_shiftLeft]
  rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
  change (((2^32 - 1) * 2^s) % 2^32) = 2^32 - 2^s
  exact mask_val_eq 32 s hs_pos hs_lt

lemma mask_val_u128 (s : Nat) (hs_pos : 0 < s) (hs_lt : s < 128) :

lemma u32_and_max (x : U32) : x &&& core.num.U32.MAX = x := by

lemma uscalar_sub_eq {ty : UScalarTy} (x y : UScalar ty) (h : ¬ x.val < y.val) :
    x - y = ok ⟨ BitVec.ofNat ty.numBits (x.val - y.val) ⟩ := by

  simp [UScalar.sub, h]

        dsimp [UScalarTy.numBits]

      have hmask_val : mask.val = 2^128 - 2^s := mask_val_u128 s hs_pos hs_lt
      have heq_iff : (nw &&& mask = ip &&& mask) ↔ (nw.val / 2^s = ip.val / 2^s) := by
        rw [u128_eq_iff_val_eq]
        simp only [UScalar.val_and]
        rw [hmask_val]
        exact nat_and_mask_eq_iff_div_eq 128 s nw.val ip.val hs_le nw.hBounds ip.hBounds
      have hmin : min p.val 128 = p.val := Nat.min_eq_left (by omega)
      have hs_eq : 128 - min p.val 128 = s := by omega
      rw [hs_eq]
      rw [decide_eq_decide.mpr heq_iff]
      rfl

theorem cidr_contains_spec (c : net.CidrRange) (a : net.IpAddr) :
    c.contains a = ok (inCidr c a) := by
  cases c
  rename_i c_net c_prefix
  cases c_net <;> cases a
  · exact cidr_contains_v4 _ c_prefix _
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · exact cidr_contains_v6 _ c_prefix _

end artifactkeeper_kernel.Solution
